purpose: Maintainer-intervention eligibility recheck; not part of the locked 10-case primary result.
reason: Contact is potentially warranted only if both the documented published install and the current default branch remain broken. If current source succeeds, the problem is already addressed upstream and release timing is not treated as a new defect.

steps.command: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/artefactory/woodtapper.git source && git -C source checkout 3c8f9ff07108d901a662326912a6d82dddaf7047
steps.name: clone current default branch

steps.command: test "$(git -C source hash-object README.md)" = "b07652102469791d6b0c1ecab597a849a9aa31ae" && test "$(git -C source hash-object pyproject.toml)" = "13ecb5be9c59a16735351bd57d8072fc7a518b6c"
steps.name: verify current README and package metadata blobs

steps.command: python -m venv published-venv && published-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
steps.name: create clean published-package environment

steps.command: python -m venv source-venv && source-venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
steps.name: create clean current-source environment

steps.command:
cat > current_task.py <<'PY'
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from woodtapper.extract_rules import SirusClassifier

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=120, n_features=6, random_state=0)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=0, stratify=y
)
model = SirusClassifier(
    n_estimators=50,
    max_depth=2,
    quantile=10,
    p0=0.01,
    random_state=0,
)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
predictions = model.predict(X_test)
assert len(predictions) == len(X_test)
print({"prediction_count": len(predictions)})
PY
source-venv/bin/python current_task.py
steps.name: run documented Sirus first-use task

steps.command: published-venv/bin/python -m pip freeze || true; echo '--- current source ---'; source-venv/bin/python -m pip freeze || true
steps.name: capture package versions
